boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Minnesota-Duluth
boards.description: Ten currently listed food destinations in Duluth with late service or late drive-thru availability; check the linked location page before leaving.

cards.title: The Gadget in Lake Superior Hall
cards.subtitle: On campus · Lake Superior Hall
cards.notes: Head to Lake Superior Hall for a grab-and-go option near the residence halls; confirm campus dining schedules before your visit.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus evening kiosk with snacks, drinks, and grab-and-go food.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Dining lists The Gadget in Lake Superior Hall and gives school-year hours of 3:30–11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Kiosks | Dining Services | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: UMD lists school-year hours as daily, 3:30–11 p.m.; summer hours differ.

cards.title: Pizza Lucé After 10
cards.subtitle: 11 East Superior Street · Downtown Duluth
cards.notes: Use the location page to choose dine-in, pickup, curbside, or delivery, and place an order before the listed 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza, hoagie, salad, and dessert stop with daily late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Lucé lists its Duluth location at 11 East Superior Street and shows dine-in, delivery, and pickup through 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists dine-in, delivery, and curbside pickup until 1 a.m. daily.

cards.title: London Road’s 2 a.m. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 2031 London Road · Duluth
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru pickup at this London Road location; indoor dining closes earlier than the posted drive-thru service.
cards.short_summary: A Duluth Taco Bell whose listed drive-thru hours extend to 2 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 2031 London Road location in Duluth with drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Duluth, MN – 2031 London Rd
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours are 7 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are listed separately to 11 p.m.

cards.title: West Duluth’s 3 a.m. Window
cards.subtitle: 201 North 44th Avenue West · Duluth
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest listed service, especially on Friday or Saturday; the dining room has earlier posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A West Duluth Taco Bell with the board’s latest verified weekend drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service at 201 North 44th Avenue West until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday and until 1 a.m. other days.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Duluth, MN – 201 North 44th Ave. W
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours: to 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday and to 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Central Entrance Until 1
cards.subtitle: 1031 West Central Entrance · Duluth
cards.notes: Check the store page and use the drive-thru when you need a late option on the Miller Hill side of Duluth.
cards.short_summary: A Central Entrance Taco Bell with a verified 1 a.m. daily drive-thru close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1031 West Central Entrance location in Duluth with drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Duluth, MN – 1031 West Central Entrance
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists drive-thru service from 7 a.m. until 1 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Miller Trunk at Midnight
cards.subtitle: 1720 Miller Trunk Highway · Duluth
cards.notes: Use the official location page for restaurant and drive-thru availability; both are currently listed through midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A Miller Trunk Highway restaurant with midnight indoor and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists its 1720 Miller Trunk Highway restaurant and drive-thru in Duluth as open from 10 a.m. to 12 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s 1720 Miller Trunk Hwy, Duluth, MN
cards.access_notes: The official page lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours as 10 a.m.–12 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Burger Paradox to 11
cards.subtitle: 2113 West Superior Street · Duluth
cards.notes: Order from the restaurant’s current menu or waitlist page and plan around its posted 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A West Superior Street burger restaurant open until 11 p.m. seven days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: Burger Paradox lists its Duluth address as 2113 West Superior Street and posts hours until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 4–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: Mall Drive Through 11
cards.subtitle: 1301 Mall Drive · Duluth
cards.notes: Check the restaurant calendar or order page before heading over; its lobby, curbside, and drive-thru share the listed late close.
cards.short_summary: A Mall Drive Culver’s with daily service through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s lists its Mall Drive restaurant in Duluth with lobby, curbside, and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Culver’s of Duluth, MN – Mall Dr
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists lobby, curbside, and drive-thru service daily until 11 p.m.

cards.title: Mall Drive’s Weekend 11
cards.subtitle: 902 Mall Drive · Duluth
cards.notes: Use the waitlist or to-go service listed by the restaurant, and reserve this option for Friday or Saturday’s 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Mall Drive steakhouse with later Friday and Saturday operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Roadhouse lists its Duluth location at 902 Mall Drive and posts Friday and Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday are listed 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; other days have earlier posted closing times.

cards.title: Fitger’s Kitchen on Friday
cards.subtitle: 600 East Superior Street · Duluth
cards.notes: Visit for the restaurant’s food service and target Friday or Saturday, when the kitchen is currently listed through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A historic Fitger’s complex restaurant with verified late-week kitchen service.
cards.evidence_claim: Fitger’s Brewhouse lists its address at 600 East Superior Street and states that its kitchen is open until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted kitchen hours are until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
